about: Blockout landmarks for the Lyris world map (T36). Generated by Art/World/make_landmarks.py; spawned by Content/Python/lyris_build_landmarks.py. Coordinates are MC blocks (1 m); UE X = MC x * 100, UE Y = MC z * 100, UE Z = (MC Y - 63) * 100.
palette_note: Material keys are the Harbor PALETTE / ISLAND_PALETTE names; see lyris_build_landmarks.MATERIALS.

landmarks.name: Moonharbor
landmarks.notes: Streets from moonharbor2/plan.py (5 m streets, 3 m lanes, the Keep Road climbing to the gate). Waterfront curtain (Witch's Wall) and quay curtain are canon (seawall/walls.py); the landward wall and its gates around the core box are placed by us so the town reads as walled.

landmarks.name: The Harbour
landmarks.notes: Promenade along the seawall (deck Y 64), four finger piers and the east quay (Net Lane). The quay is the deep-water berth; the Seawall Stair, Lantern Pier and the statue are their own landmarks.

landmarks.name: Market Square and the Moonwell
landmarks.notes: Square paving, the Moonwell pool (water Y 65.9), Town Hall, Museum and the clock tower. Building spots inside the square are ours (canon gives the square, not each building).

landmarks.name: Main Street and the Bright Cask
landmarks.notes: Shop row (hatter, dressmaker, bakery, apothecary, library) on both sides of Main Street; the Bright Cask tavern at its head by Festival Green.

landmarks.name: Moonmarket and the Constabulary
landmarks.notes: Moonmarket plaza; the Lamp Seller's stall sells the first lamp oil

landmarks.name: Grand Library
landmarks.notes: The town's great library and its court

landmarks.name: Miners' Guild
landmarks.notes: Deepkin miners; their deep chapel lies under the Guild. Drift mouth at x 412-424, z -2432..-2412

landmarks.name: Carriage Station
landmarks.notes: Where the roads leave town (the North Road starts here); the Wayfarers' shrine stands by it

landmarks.name: Boatyard at the Point
landmarks.notes: The shipwright's shore building

landmarks.name: South Hall
landmarks.notes: The big hall on the south edge of town

landmarks.name: The Seawall Stair
landmarks.notes: Seven steps down from the promenade (Y 63 at z -2358 to Y 57), the landing at Y 56 under water, broken steps on into the deep. Top step XLI at z -2357 carries the 41 notches: never repair it. Stair Towers either side.

landmarks.name: Lantern Pier
landmarks.notes: Pier from the promenade out to the Tide Mother's driftwood shrine under whale-rib arches (pier end 136, 66.6, -2418). T37: the player boat, dock and dock lamp move here; the berth is on the pier's east side (markers T37_*).

markers.note: Player boat start: moored on Lantern Pier's east side, bow north toward the bay mouth
ALyrisDockLamp / T3 lamp component goes here
Where the player steps from the boat onto the pier

landmarks.name: Ilwen's Lighthouse
landmarks.notes: Terrace floor Y 70 (r 13.5), the keeper's hall drum (r 10), a slender calcite shaft to the gallery deck at Y 127 and the great lamp. Cold light only (Elven Night). The copper oil cistern: 'Pour a tin. Keep her lit.' A sweeping beam is World lane work (T3).

landmarks.name: Chapel of Lamps
landmarks.notes: Home of the Lantern Covenant, with the Lamp Tree over the altar. Between the town and the lighthouse; spot placed by us.

landmarks.name: Syrena's statue and the Hung Star
landmarks.notes: The statue on its islet in the bay, sword (Ysolde's Thorn) pointing due north 40 degrees up at the pole star; the false star hangs at the tip (245.5, 139.5, -2510.5) and never turns. She wears a wide witch's hat where her crown should be.

landmarks.name: Keep Elariel and the Moon Window
landmarks.notes: Walls x 470-576, z -2565..-2527, gate at (501, 138, -2526) facing the Keep Road; four front towers; the keep and cathedral (Moonwake) inside; the Moon Window garden with its lamp kept lit by Syrena and Sir Cog kneeling there; the Moon Chapel on a terrace west of the keep (spot ours).

landmarks.notes: 22 house blocks along the district's own streets in its own style (Sail walls, Terracotta roofs). Districts as in moonharbor2/mplots.py; house plots are ours, the server's own plots are not exported yet.

landmarks.name: Oruth, the Fallen Star
landmarks.notes: The Chamber of the Hollow Star: a glass dome (x -135..-105) on the floor of the bay pit (floor Y -39), with the singing star's crystal heart inside, breathing light every 24 s (World/Audio later). Readable from a boat over the pit on calm days.

landmarks.name: The Grand Observatory
landmarks.notes: Aurenn star platform (terraces r 32, 27, 21 at +0, +2, +3 m), the drum (r 14) to the wall plate at +23 m, a pointed dome (r 15, 1.3 taller than wide) with its slit on the south meridian, twelve peristyle columns (r 19). The Great Refractor looks out of the slit at 65 degrees. Half ruined: the restoration scaffold stands against the west wall. Hoarfeather's perch nearby. The academy hub.

landmarks.name: The North Road
landmarks.notes: From the Carriage Station north past the Observatory spur to the Delvers' Gate, about 2.1 km here, lamp-lined with pilgrims' cairns. Lantern V (Tobin Marsh's last) at (980, -2905). Route is ours between the canon ends. Lantern V is placed dark: it went out when Tobin vanished.

landmarks.name: The Delvers' Gate
landmarks.notes: A winding cleft to a sunken court and the great round brass door (1820, 155, -3955): THE STAR SLEEPS UNDER THE WATER. The Remnant's rubble wall across the cleft mouth, the Lodge with the Delvers' Roll, and the lamplighter's lantern still burning by the door.

landmarks.name: The Teeth
landmarks.notes: A reef in the channel north of the bay mouth (sea Y 56 there); Syrena swims there at dawn. Spot placed by us.

landmarks.name: Hollowmere ruins and the Herring Road bridge
landmarks.notes: The droving village that burned on the third mist night: roofless walls either side of the river, the herring-a-barrel toll bridge, a singing-stone waymark with its top chipped. Spot placed by us.

landmarks.name: The Under-Halls gate
landmarks.notes: The Deepkin mine-holds that shut at dusk and never lost a soul: a carved gate in the grey mountains. Spot placed by us.

landmarks.name: Waystone ring A
landmarks.notes: Tuned Aurenn stones that carried the star's song inland; THE STAR SLEEPS UNDER THE WATER cut on the centre stone (the red line). Flat upland site from the gazetteer.

landmarks.name: Saltreach landing
landmarks.notes: A wild landing, no town yet: a timber jetty out from the beach, a cairn and a lamp.

landmarks.name: Sunreach landing
landmarks.notes: A wild landing, no town yet. The gazetteer spot is 230 m inland; the jetty is on the north shore below it, with a cairn path up to the waymark.

landmarks.name: Lampwick Skerries
landmarks.notes: Lampwick Skerries: one dark lamp post on each islet, for new players to relight. Terrain from bake_terrain.ISLANDS; lamps are placed dark (relighting is World lane T3).

landmarks.name: Hushed Isles
landmarks.notes: Hushed Isles: a silent bell tower beside the lamp. Terrain from bake_terrain.ISLANDS; lamps are placed dark (relighting is World lane T3).

landmarks.name: Wickstones
landmarks.notes: Wickstones: the waystone ring stands in the clearing on the biggest isle. Terrain from bake_terrain.ISLANDS; lamps are placed dark (relighting is World lane T3).

landmarks.name: Wickstones waystone ring
landmarks.notes: The ring that answers the rings on the Reach uplands, in the flat clearing the bake leaves on the biggest isle.

landmarks.name: Tallow Banks
landmarks.notes: Tallow Banks: a drying rack and rendering shed for lanterneel oil. Terrain from bake_terrain.ISLANDS; lamps are placed dark (relighting is World lane T3).

landmarks.name: Southing Stones
landmarks.notes: Southing Stones: the navigators' cairn. Terrain from bake_terrain.ISLANDS; lamps are placed dark (relighting is World lane T3).

landmarks.name: Rime Skerries
landmarks.notes: Rime Skerries: a frozen beacon. Terrain from bake_terrain.ISLANDS; lamps are placed dark (relighting is World lane T3).

landmarks.name: Unremembered Isles
landmarks.notes: Unremembered Isles: a pale, half-drawn beacon. Terrain from bake_terrain.ISLANDS; lamps are placed dark (relighting is World lane T3).

landmarks.name: Ember Isle
landmarks.notes: Ember Isle: a plain beacon; no volcano (DECISIONS 2026-10-20), purpose still open. Terrain from bake_terrain.ISLANDS; lamps are placed dark (relighting is World lane T3).
